dialogues.jp: 「ただいま〜」
dialogues.en: "I'm back~"
dialogues.text: "I'm back~"

dialogues.jp:
買い物から戻ると、ことりはさっきと同じよう
に、椅子に座ってうなだれていた。俺の声に、
視線だけ向け、弱い笑みを浮かべる。
dialogues.en:
Having gone out to buy drinks, I returned to find Kotori in
the same spot, sitting on a chair. She gave me a weak smile.
dialogues.text:
Having gone out to buy drinks, I returned to find Kotori in
the same spot, sitting on a chair. She gave me a weak smile.

dialogues.jp:
「ほい、お待たせ。とりあえずホットの紅茶に
　したけど、それで良かったかな？」
dialogues.en: "Here you go. You drink black tea, right?"
dialogues.text: "Here you go. You drink black tea, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "...Thank you."
dialogues.text: "...Thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「取ってくれるか」
dialogues.en: "Take one."
dialogues.text: "Take one."

dialogues.jp:
腕に４本の缶ジュースを抱えているので、手を
使えない。
dialogues.en:
With my arms carrying 4 cans, I couldn't pass her one
myself.
dialogues.text:
With my arms carrying 4 cans, I couldn't pass her one
myself.

dialogues.jp:
ことりが受け取った後、友達のふたりにも配っ
て、再びことりのそばに戻った。
dialogues.en:
After Kotori took one, I passed two more to the two friends,
then went back to Kotori's side.
dialogues.text:
After Kotori took one, I passed two more to the two friends,
then went back to Kotori's side.

dialogues.jp: 「……と、これも買ってきたんだった」
dialogues.en: "...I got this for you too."
dialogues.text: "...I got this for you too."

dialogues.jp:
自由になった手をポケットに突っ込み、中身を
取り出す。
dialogues.en: I reached deep into my pocket, and pulled it out.
dialogues.text: I reached deep into my pocket, and pulled it out.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……チョコレート」
dialogues.en: "...Chocolate?"
dialogues.text: "...Chocolate?"

dialogues.jp:
こめかみの辺りを指先で揉みながら、ことりが
呟く。
dialogues.en: Kotori rubbed her fingers on her temples as she murmured.
dialogues.text: Kotori rubbed her fingers on her temples as she murmured.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、良かったら。嫌いじゃないだろ？」
dialogues.en: "If you want to. Do you like chocolate?"
dialogues.text: "If you want to. Do you like chocolate?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん……。ごめんね」
dialogues.en: "Yeah... I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "Yeah... I'm sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いやいや。何の何の」
dialogues.en: "No no, think nothing of it."
dialogues.text: "No no, think nothing of it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ふう……。ごほっ、ごほっ」
dialogues.en: "Oh... *cough cough*"
dialogues.text: "Oh... *cough cough*"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「薬とかは飲んできたのか？」
dialogues.en: "Have you taken your medicine yet?"
dialogues.text: "Have you taken your medicine yet?"

dialogues.jp:
プルトップを開ける。静まり返った部屋に、そ
の音がやけに大きく響いた。
dialogues.en:
She opened the can of her medicine. In the quiet room, such
a small action made a noise that echoed throughout the room.
dialogues.text:
She opened the can of her medicine. In the quiet room, such
a small action made a noise that echoed throughout the room.

dialogues.jp: 「……ああ、どうぞどうぞ。遠慮せずに」
dialogues.en: "...Ahh, go ahead, don't mind me."
dialogues.text: "...Ahh, go ahead, don't mind me."

dialogues.jp:
壁際に突っ立っているふたりに呼びかける。と
いうか、何で離れてるんだろ？
dialogues.en:
I called that out to the two against the wall. What're they
doing so far away?
dialogues.text:
I called that out to the two against the wall. What're they
doing so far away?

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……ふたりとも、恥ずかしがり屋さんなんで
　すよ」
dialogues.en:
"...Those two are a bit embarassed about talking to our
so-called manager."
dialogues.text:
"...Those two are a bit embarassed about talking to our
so-called manager."

dialogues.jp:
俺の疑問を察したように、軽く笑みを浮かべ、
ことりが答えた。
dialogues.en:
Guessing my question, Kotori answered while giving me a
little smile.
dialogues.text:
Guessing my question, Kotori answered while giving me a
little smile.

dialogues.jp:
微笑みは、顔面の蒼白さを際だたせた。疲れ、
魂が抜けたような印象を、一層強める。
dialogues.en:
Her smile seemed so pale. It showed tiredness, as if her
very soul had left her.
dialogues.text:
Her smile seemed so pale. It showed tiredness, as if her
very soul had left her.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「薬は……飲んできましたよ」
dialogues.en: "I've... finished taking my medicine."
dialogues.text: "I've... finished taking my medicine."

dialogues.jp: 壁際からの声に、俺は目を向けた。
dialogues.en:
Hearing a voice from the direction of the wall, I turned my
eyes to look at the two leaners.
dialogues.text:
Hearing a voice from the direction of the wall, I turned my
eyes to look at the two leaners.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、彼女はともちゃんって言います。もう
　一人の子が、みっくん」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, the girl who just spoke is Tomo-chan. The other one is
Mik-kun."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, the girl who just spoke is Tomo-chan. The other one is
Mik-kun."

dialogues.jp: 何で、女子なのに“くん”？
dialogues.en: People address her with the "kun" honorific?
dialogues.text: People address her with the "kun" honorific?

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「今日はもう、止めにしておく？」
dialogues.en: "Should we stop for today?"
dialogues.text: "Should we stop for today?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ううん……ごほっ、えほっ……大丈夫だから。
　私は、大丈夫……」
dialogues.en: "Uun... *cough cough*... it's alright... I'm fine..."
dialogues.text: "Uun... *cough cough*... it's alright... I'm fine..."

dialogues.jp: ｛かす／微｝かに顔をしかめ、指先を頭に持っていく。
dialogues.en: Looking weak, Kotori returned her fingers to her temples.
dialogues.text: Looking weak, Kotori returned her fingers to her temples.

dialogues.jp: 「頭も痛いのか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you having a headache?"
dialogues.text: "Are you having a headache?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……これは、いつもの事だから」
dialogues.en: "...This happens all the time."
dialogues.text: "...This happens all the time."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Uh?"
dialogues.text: "Uh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「私、頭痛持ちなんです……だから、気にしな
　いでいいんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"I get a lot of headaches... so this isn't anything special,
please don't worry about it."
dialogues.text:
"I get a lot of headaches... so this isn't anything special,
please don't worry about it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「つっても……風邪引きでさらに頭痛じゃ、さ
　すがに辛いだろ？　ここは、ともちゃんの言
　う通り……」
dialogues.en:
"Well, but... a bad cold along with constant headaches must
be painful, right? At this point, you should follow
Tomo-chan's advice..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, but... a bad cold along with constant headaches must
be painful, right? At this point, you should follow
Tomo-chan's advice..."

dialogues.jp: ことりは、穏やかに首を振った。
dialogues.en: Kotori gently leaned her head to the side.
dialogues.text: Kotori gently leaned her head to the side.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「しばらく経てば……治りますから。さっきは、
　ちょっと、その……」
dialogues.en: "I'd be fine after... a little rest. Just now, it was..."
dialogues.text: "I'd be fine after... a little rest. Just now, it was..."

dialogues.jp:
口をつぐみ、言い淀む。少しして、ことりはそっ
と言葉を押し出した。
dialogues.en:
Kotori hesitated mid-sentence. After a few seconds, she
squeezed it out.
dialogues.text:
Kotori hesitated mid-sentence. After a few seconds, she
squeezed it out.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「人がいっぱい居たから……」
dialogues.en: "There were so many people..."
dialogues.text: "There were so many people..."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「あの……朝倉君……ですよね？」
dialogues.en: "Um... you're Asakura-kun... right?"
dialogues.text: "Um... you're Asakura-kun... right?"

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　ああ、うん、そう」
dialogues.en: "...It somehow doesn't feel like we've just met."
dialogues.text: "...It somehow doesn't feel like we've just met."

dialogues.jp: みっくんは、ふっと顔をほころばせた。
dialogues.en:
She then timidly held out her hand, as if she'd never heard
the words "Nice to meet you" before.
dialogues.text:
She then timidly held out her hand, as if she'd never heard
the words "Nice to meet you" before.

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「……何だか初対面って感じがしませんね」
dialogues.en:
I took her hand lightly and gave it a little handshake. Her
hand felt cold to the touch, unlike mine.
dialogues.text:
I took her hand lightly and gave it a little handshake. Her
hand felt cold to the touch, unlike mine.

dialogues.jp: ともちゃんの手を引き、とことこ歩いてくる。
dialogues.en:
"I'm Asakura... Asakura [name]. Nice to meet you. But, er, how
did you know who I am?"
dialogues.text:
"I'm Asakura... Asakura [name]. Nice to meet you. But, er, how
did you know who I am?"

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp:
「話だけは……ことりから、しょっちゅう聞か
　されていましたから」
dialogues.en: "I've heard a lot... Kotori talks about you all the time."
dialogues.text: "I've heard a lot... Kotori talks about you all the time."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「……ことりから？」
dialogues.en: "...Kotori... did?"
dialogues.text: "...Kotori... did?"

dialogues.jp:
親しさを感じさせる目で、ことりはみっくんを
｛にら／睨｝んだ。
dialogues.en:
Kotori scowled at Mik-kun, albeit with eyes that denoted a
sense of closeness.
dialogues.text:
Kotori scowled at Mik-kun, albeit with eyes that denoted a
sense of closeness.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「も〜、それは言わない約束でしょう、おっか
　さん」
dialogues.en:
"Geez~, you promised me you wouldn't say anything about
that, mother."
dialogues.text:
"Geez~, you promised me you wouldn't say anything about
that, mother."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「俺の話……どんな？」
dialogues.en: "Talks about me... like what?"
dialogues.text: "Talks about me... like what?"

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「秘密です」
dialogues.en: "That's a secret."
dialogues.text: "That's a secret."

dialogues.jp: みっくんはにっこり微笑んだ。
dialogues.en: Mik-kun smiled wolfishly.
dialogues.text: Mik-kun smiled wolfishly.

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「ことりから、ダメ出しされちゃいましたから」
dialogues.en: "Kotori wouldn't like it if I say anything more."
dialogues.text: "Kotori wouldn't like it if I say anything more."

dialogues.jp:
ことりはやや赤い顔をして──血色が戻ってき
た──唇を不満げに突き出している。
dialogues.en:
Kotori was red as a tomato -- which was at least better than
pale as a ghost -- and stuck out her lower-lip poutingly.
dialogues.text:
Kotori was red as a tomato -- which was at least better than
pale as a ghost -- and stuck out her lower-lip poutingly.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ダメって事はないけど……本人が聞いたって、
　きっと面白くないもん」
dialogues.en:
"It's not that I don't want to say it but... it's not
interesting for the person in question."
dialogues.text:
"It's not that I don't want to say it but... it's not
interesting for the person in question."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「いや、面白いかどうかは別として、気になる
　かなと」
dialogues.en: "No, even if it's not interesting, I don't mind hearing it."
dialogues.text: "No, even if it's not interesting, I don't mind hearing it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「う〜……じゃ、やっぱりダメ」
dialogues.en: "Uuu~... still no."
dialogues.text: "Uuu~... still no."

dialogues.jp:
ぴしゃんと言って、缶ジュースのプルトップを
開けた。
dialogues.en: Rejecting my plea, she opened her juice can.
dialogues.text: Rejecting my plea, she opened her juice can.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「美味しいよね、紅茶って」
dialogues.en: "This black tea is good."
dialogues.text: "This black tea is good."

dialogues.jp:
にっこり笑うことりは、もう普段の顔色に戻っ
てきていた。
dialogues.en: The usual sweet smile. Her normal face had returned.
dialogues.text: The usual sweet smile. Her normal face had returned.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ごほっ……チョコももらうね」
dialogues.en: "*cough*... The chocolate as well."
dialogues.text: "*cough*... The chocolate as well."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「どうぞどうぞ」
dialogues.en: "It's all yours."
dialogues.text: "It's all yours."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp:
「あの……朝倉君、さ。さっき、マネージャー
　とか言ってたけど、それは……？」
dialogues.en:
"Um... Asakura-kun. Earlier, your talk about you being the
manager... was that...?"
dialogues.text:
"Um... Asakura-kun. Earlier, your talk about you being the
manager... was that...?"

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、そりゃもちろん、デタラメ。奴らを追
　い出すための、まあ、嘘も方便ってやつ」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, it was just nonsense. I had to find some way to chase
everyone out, so I made up a fib."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, it was just nonsense. I had to find some way to chase
everyone out, so I made up a fib."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp:
「あの人数を向こうに、暴れ回るってのも無茶
　な話だしな」
dialogues.en: "That unruly mob could've probably rioted at any time."
dialogues.text: "That unruly mob could've probably rioted at any time."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「……そうだったんですか」
dialogues.en: "...Yeah, you're right."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah, you're right."

dialogues.jp:
笑みを浮かべ、それがすぐに、沈んだ表情になっ
てしまう。
dialogues.en:
Tomo-chan laughed a bit, but had a dejected look on her
face.
dialogues.text:
Tomo-chan laughed a bit, but had a dejected look on her
face.

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp:
「入らないで下さいって……言ったんですけど
　ね。後から後からやって来て……」
dialogues.en:
"We've told them plenty of times... not to come in. But they
keep doing so anyway..."
dialogues.text:
"We've told them plenty of times... not to come in. But they
keep doing so anyway..."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp:
「練習を始めないわけにもいかないから、黙っ
　ていたんですけど……そうしたら、あんな事
　に」
dialogues.en:
"We'd normally go on with practice since we can't wait for
them to get bored... then that happened."
dialogues.text:
"We'd normally go on with practice since we can't wait for
them to get bored... then that happened."

dialogues.jp:
ともちゃんは缶ジュースをぎゅっと握りしめ、
床に視線を落とした。
dialogues.en:
Tomo-chan gripped her can tightly, her gaze falling to the
floor.
dialogues.text:
Tomo-chan gripped her can tightly, her gaze falling to the
floor.

dialogues.jp: 「うぐ……悪かった。俺もその一人だしな」
dialogues.en: "...Ugh, I'm sorry. I was part of that too, after all..."
dialogues.text: "...Ugh, I'm sorry. I was part of that too, after all..."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp:
「あ、いえいえっ。朝倉君が来るかもって事は、
　ことりから聞いてましたからっ」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, no no no. Kotori already told us that you would be
coming to hear us."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, no no no. Kotori already told us that you would be
coming to hear us."

dialogues.jp:
手と首をもの凄い勢いで振る。飛んでって行か
ないかと心配だったり。
dialogues.en:
Tomo-chan waved her hand and head rapidly. She seemed
genuinely afraid that I thought I was a bother...
dialogues.text:
Tomo-chan waved her hand and head rapidly. She seemed
genuinely afraid that I thought I was a bother...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉君はいいんだよ。だって、マネージャー
　さんだもん。ね」
dialogues.en: "Both ways, Asakura-kun would make a good manager, right?"
dialogues.text: "Both ways, Asakura-kun would make a good manager, right?"

dialogues.jp:
どっちに対する呼びかけなのかを確認して、俺
は言った。
dialogues.en: My first instinct was to oppose what she said.
dialogues.text: My first instinct was to oppose what she said.

dialogues.jp:
「いや、ねって言われてもな……だって、あれ
　は単なる口から出まかせで……」
dialogues.en: "No, not really... all I did was open my big mouth..."
dialogues.text: "No, not really... all I did was open my big mouth..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ほんとにしたって、いいじゃないですか」
dialogues.en: "Even just that is good enough!"
dialogues.text: "Even just that is good enough!"

dialogues.jp:
俺の顔をじっと見つめてくる。口調は軽いが、
瞳は真剣だった。
dialogues.en:
Kotori kept her gaze on me. Her tone was light, but her eyes
were serious.
dialogues.text:
Kotori kept her gaze on me. Her tone was light, but her eyes
were serious.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君……お願い出来ませんか？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun... would you please be our manager?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun... would you please be our manager?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「まあ……ことり達がそれでいいって言うなら、
　俺は構わないけど」
dialogues.en:
"Well... if you three are fine with it, I have no
objections."
dialogues.text:
"Well... if you three are fine with it, I have no
objections."

dialogues.jp:
ことりがふたりに目を向ける。ふたりはお互い
に顔を見合わせると、同時にうなずいた。
dialogues.en:
Kotori turned her head towards her friends. The two of them
looked at each other, then at Kotori as they both nodded in
assent.
dialogues.text:
Kotori turned her head towards her friends. The two of them
looked at each other, then at Kotori as they both nodded in
assent.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そんな訳で、お願いしますね」
dialogues.en: "Congratulations, you're our new manager."
dialogues.text: "Congratulations, you're our new manager."

dialogues.jp:
にっこりと笑う。もう、普段のことりに戻って
いた。
dialogues.en: A laughing smile. Looks like the old Kotori has returned.
dialogues.text: A laughing smile. Looks like the old Kotori has returned.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……ごほっ、ごほっ」
dialogues.en: "...*cough cough*"
dialogues.text: "...*cough cough*"

dialogues.jp: 咳を除けば。
dialogues.en: Except for the coughing.
dialogues.text: Except for the coughing.

dialogues.jp:
「ま、マネージャーたって、俺に出来る事なん
　てないけどな」
dialogues.en: "Really though, I have no idea what a manager should do..."
dialogues.text: "Really though, I have no idea what a manager should do..."

dialogues.jp:
肩をすくめてみせる。謙遜でも何でもなくて、
まあ、事実だ。
dialogues.en:
I slumped my shoulders slightly and shrugged. Modest or
humble or whatever, that was the plain truth.
dialogues.text:
I slumped my shoulders slightly and shrugged. Modest or
humble or whatever, that was the plain truth.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「居てくれるだけでいいんですよ」
dialogues.en: "As long as you just stay here, it'd be fine."
dialogues.text: "As long as you just stay here, it'd be fine."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「じゃ、練習再開しよ。まだ、後１時間くらい
　は部屋を使えるでしょう？」
dialogues.en:
"Let's resume practice. We still have the room reserved for
about one more hour, right?"
dialogues.text:
"Let's resume practice. We still have the room reserved for
about one more hour, right?"

dialogues.jp:
椅子から立ち上がる。みっくんとともちゃんが、
それぞれベースとピアノの位置に着く。
dialogues.en:
Kotori stood up from her chair. Mik-kun and Tomo-chan also
returned to their places at the piano and bass respectively.
dialogues.text:
Kotori stood up from her chair. Mik-kun and Tomo-chan also
returned to their places at the piano and bass respectively.

dialogues.jp: そして、演奏が始まった。
dialogues.en: Then, the performance started once more.
dialogues.text: Then, the performance started once more.

dialogues.jp:
途中、何度か咳のためにストップしたけれど、
さっき以上に、心打たれる歌と演奏だった。
dialogues.en:
More than once, it stopped due to untimely coughs, but they
continued best as they could for the remaining hour.
dialogues.text:
More than once, it stopped due to untimely coughs, but they
continued best as they could for the remaining hour.

dialogues.jp: ◆マネージャー◆
dialogues.en: ◆Manager◆
dialogues.text: ◆Manager◆

dialogues.jp: 野次馬を追い出すために言った適当な嘘。
dialogues.en: I made up a lie to shoo away the curious onlookers.
dialogues.text: I made up a lie to shoo away the curious onlookers.

dialogues.jp:
それが元で俺はことりたちのマネージャーをす
ることになった。
dialogues.en:
Then Kotori suggested that the lie might not be a bad thing
to be the truth, and I became their manager.
dialogues.text:
Then Kotori suggested that the lie might not be a bad thing
to be the truth, and I became their manager.

dialogues.jp:
４人だけの音楽室に響く、さっき以上に心打た
れる歌と演奏。
dialogues.en:
With just the 4 of us remaining, they practiced hard and
long without any unneeded interruptions.
dialogues.text:
With just the 4 of us remaining, they practiced hard and
long without any unneeded interruptions.

dialogues.jp:
